title: Al Mashreq For Chemicals
description: Al Mashreq for Chemicals is a specialized agricultural solutions company providing fertilizers and crop-enhancement products that support farmers and agricultural businesses across the region. The objective of this project was to develop a professional visual identity capable of strengthening brand recognition, creating consistency across multiple product lines, and establishing a trustworthy presence within the agricultural market.
challenge: The agricultural chemicals market is highly competitive, with many brands relying on generic visual identities that fail to create differentiation or long-term recognition. Al Mashreq needed a visual identity that could communicate professionalism, trust, and agricultural expertise while remaining flexible enough to accommodate a growing range of products and packaging formats. The challenge was not only to design a logo, but to create a complete visual system capable of supporting the brand across every customer touchpoint.
solution: A complete brand identity system was developed, including logo design, typography, color palette, print materials, and brand applications to ensure consistency across all touchpoints.
results: The final identity transformed Al Mashreq into a more recognizable and professional agricultural solutions brand. By combining a scalable visual system with consistent packaging and communication materials, the project established a strong foundation for future growth while enhancing brand credibility across the agricultural market.
